english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) by a means calculated to choke, suffocate or strangle, attempted to render **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) insensible, unconscious, or incapable of resistance with intent thereby to

(A)_[enable you to commit]_

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: 'Indictable' offence in this case includes 'either way' offences.
